articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan
articles.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the Ukraine war, new estimate suggests - NBC News
articles.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.
